title: Power Rail Definition
description: Defines a rail family: nominal voltage expectations, common topology, and the controller-independent measurement keys the diagnostic engine uses. Rail voltages are TYPICAL expectations, not absolute truth — the engine never assumes a measured board matches.

common_controllers.description: Part numbers commonly seen on this rail. The engine MUST NOT assume any specific controller from the rail name alone.

platform.description: Which platform this rail belongs to. 'universal' for rails present on both (e.g. RTC). Defaults to 'laptop' for legacy rails that pre-date the platform split.

measurement_keys.description: Canonical measurement keys used by the engine for this rail family.
